How to Get 1.1 Million Views with your phone like @evertrail.tours - Instructions ð 

- I turned my camera horizontally and got a shot acting like I pulled the screen open
- Then ran back and jumped 3 times
- I got 2 more horizontal shots of different areas
- And imported those into capcut
- I hit aspect ratio > 9x16
- Then I added my text and made sure it stretched the whole timeline
- I duplicated my first clip and dropped it right underneath the original
- Then turned the opacity down to 0 of the original clip
- I moved the duplicate up to cover the text
- Tapped layers, and hit front
- Then hit mask > mirror > positioned it where my hands would go
- I hit the keyframe button right before I swiped my hands open
- Moved a few frames forward and expanded the mask
- I cut the text so it started after the mask expanded
- Then I scrolled to right before I landed my first jump, hit the kayframe button
- Scolled 4-5 frames forward and moved the video slightly down to reveal the text
- Did the same for jump 2 and 3
- And when I landed my third jump had the two other clips start in their respective positions
